findings.detail: This PR adds a local control surface that can close serving admission, cancel in-flight inference after 120s, and unload every model. Callers are code-signature-authenticated sockets (AddonPeerPolicy.authenticate) and the operator mailbox (handleAddonControl). No TB/T entry covers this boundary: socket location and permissions, per-connection versus per-request authentication, lease bounds, or the rule that an expired lease is kept while the machine lock is held (ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift:322-334, 142-146). The lock appears to be observed through a plain file, so any same-UID process that takes it could keep the provider held indefinitely. The same-UID user is already the operator (ADV-001), so this is an availability and documentation gap rather than a confidentiality regression. Fix: add a TB entry and threat for the add-on hold, recording the peer policy, lease clamps, machine-lock semantics and fail-open on an unreadable hold record (ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift:366-368).
findings.title: New add-on local IPC/mailbox control channel is not covered by the threat model
